summary: [Meta Graph API] authorization: OAuth via Facebook Login for Business: user tokens, Page tokens (some non-expiring: treat like root keys), System User tokens for server-side (non-expiring: vault). Granular permissions, many requiring App Review (pages_manage_posts, pages_read_engagement, read_insights, publish_video). Error 190 = OAuth family; error_subcode (458/460/463/467) gives the real cause.
